name: Uozumi Kanta
source:
A second-year student at Kuroyo Academy.

The son of the president of Uozumi Real Estate.

He's not particularly good at studying and is full of insecurities, but because his parents are big shots, even if his grades aren't particularly good, he's sure to get a backdoor admission to a prestigious university through his parents' connections.

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonochikai/]the official site[/url]]
